message:
Blog slugs now keep the base letter of accented characters, so "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes all 3 tests.

The cause was in `vendor/slugify/index.js`, which deletes any character outside `a-z0-9`, so `è` and `û` disappeared. That file is marked "do not edit by hand", and the shop's `productUrl` also uses it. So I changed `src/blog/slug.js` instead. It now strips accents (Unicode NFD normalization, then removing the combining marks) before calling slugify.

Shop product URLs still drop accented letters, because I left them alone. If you want the same fix there, the better route is probably upgrading the vendored slugify, as the vendor README describes.
